messages:
rachel: FYI scheduling a staggered FF rollout for cache-service during the 03:00 UTC change window. want a conservative backoff plan to observe cache-priming effects.

rachel: plan: deploy with feature off. schedule toggles: +10m->0.5%, +25m->3%, +50m->20%, +90m->100%. backoff rule: if p95 delta > 80ms or 5xx_count doubles -> step back one level and pause. full rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained 3m. pin routing to cache-v1 on rollback.

tom: add pause_on_alert=infra.* and sticky_cohort=internal_perf. Also include manual_confirm_after_pause=true.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle tb-6480200000-Z; flag=cache_prefetch_v2; schedule=[+10m:0.5%,+25m:3%,+50m:20%,+90m:100%]; backoff_policy=step-back-and-pause; rollback_triggers=[5xx>1%,p95_delta>80ms]; pause_on_alert=infra.*; sticky_cohort=internal_perf; initiator=rachel

dee: ops, can you stage a pin for eu-west routing? pin-6480200000-eu -> router->cache-v1.

ops-oncall: pin staged, will apply automatically on rollback command. rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480200000-Z`. dashboard link posted.

qa-bot: smoke tests configured: `tests/smoke/cache_smoke.sh` will run after each successful ramp. results posted here.

rachel: add deploy command to release notes: `./deploy --svc=cache --image=ghcr.redwood/cache:v2 --ff=cache_prefetch_v2=off`. include note: "staggered backoff ramp to watch cache warmup and downstream queueing."

(03:00 UTC - deploy logs)
```
Deploy started: cache-service v2
Image: ghcr.redwood/cache:v2
FF cache_prefetch_v2=OFF
Instances: 14 -> 14
Healthchecks: passing
```

qa-bot: initial smoke: internal_perf ok, baseline p95=95ms.

deploy-bot: 0.5% toggle executed @03:10.

qa-bot: post-step smoke @03:15: p95 +12ms, 5xx unchanged.

deploy-bot: 3% toggle executed @03:25.

ops-oncall: alert infra.queue_depth rising at 03:28; paused rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by alert infra.queue_depth; manual_confirm_after_pause required.

tom: gather traces for 03:20-03:30. do not auto-resume until we have root cause.

ops-oncall: traces show downstream worker backpressure when cache miss rate spikes during priming. 5xx count increased by 60% but still < rollback threshold.

rachel: per backoff policy, step back one level to 0.5% and soak for 20m, then reassess.

deploy-bot: backoff executed: reduced from 3% -> 0.5% and soak timer set for 20m.

qa-bot: smoke after backoff @03:40: p95 returned near baseline, 5xx trending down.

rachel: given soak looks okay, we can try a gentler step to 1% in next window after config tweak (throttle worker concurrency). for tonight, let's rollback to be safe and leave pin ready.

ops-oncall: agree — initiate rollback to ensure no overnight surprises.

deploy-bot: rollback command received: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480200000-Z` executed @03:45. flag cache_prefetch_v2=OFF; pin applied pin-6480200000-eu.

ops-oncall: pin applied and verified; traffic reverted to cache-v1. post-rollback smoke OK.

rachel: adding release note: "Staggered backoff ramp paused due to queue depth during cache priming; automated step-back and manual rollback executed; routing pinned to v1. Follow-up ticket #3352 created to tune worker concurrency and retry backoff."

tom: retro: consider starting at 0.25% for cache-heavy services and add an automatic pre-check: queue_depth < 50 before stepping up.

deploy-bot: tb-6480200000-Z closed: reason=manual rollback; closed_by=ops-oncall; closed_at=6480200125

rachel: thanks all. follow-up ticket will include traces and recommended config change. Standby for reattempt after fixes."
